description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hindagala, Kandy Four Gravets & Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320293 (24/0112)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and legal status. The content focuses entirely on land registration, property ownership determinations, and cadastral information, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
